component.name: cve-gate-canary
component.description: Synthetic fixture SBOM for the CVE gate canary (see docs/cve-gate.md). Contains exactly one component pinned to a version with a permanent, unambiguous, decades-old CVE record so the canary job never depends on how recently a CVE was disclosed or whether NVD has gotten around to analyzing it. If Grype reports zero findings for this SBOM, the CVE gate is neutered — treat that as a pipeline-breaking failure, not a fluke.

components.name: openssl
components.description: Deliberately vulnerable fixture version — OpenSSL 1.0.1 through 1.0.1f is affected by CVE-2014-0160 (Heartbleed). Do not update this version; the canary requires a known-bad, permanently-catalogued CVE.
